# The most tests the Windows job (windows-paths.yml, "zn-gate unit tests") may skip: the sum of the "skipped"
# lines that node --test prints in the output of npm test. The job fails above this number and only prints it below.
# When tests stop being skipped on Windows, lower the number to the one the job prints. Raise it only for a
# test that cannot run on Windows, and give that test a skip reason.
# The value is the count the job printed on the GitHub runner.
# 446: the 432 of main plus 14 tests that cannot run on Windows, each with its reason in its skip: 4 symbolic-link and folder-mode tests from #1190, 1 symbolic-link test from #805, and 9 from #878 (4 Linux quota errno, 2 POSIX shell script, 3 Linux clipboard tools).
# 475: the 446 above plus 29 tests the Windows job skips, each with its reason in its skip: 14 POSIX link tests of the project guard and the OpenCode project plugin (hooks_project_guard_links, hooks_project_guard_links_case); 9 project guard tests built on sh and a ":" PATH (hooks_project_guard_loader_env, hooks_project_guard_modules); 4 project guard preload tests and 2 real-library preload tests that run on Linux only (hooks_launcher_preload). Their Windows behavior is covered by the PowerShell launcher and Windows guard tests.
# 492: the 475 above plus 17 tests of the static hook launcher (hooks_static_launcher) that the Windows job skips, each with its reason in its skip: 14 that need the launcher binary built for Linux (6 installed-hook tests each for Claude Code and ZCode, the failed hook start and the package update refresh), and 3 that run on Linux only (which agents get the launcher, a copy without it, a launcher whose SHA-256 does not match). 492 is the count the Windows job printed on the GitHub runner for the same change on release/1.18.0.
492
